newsitem.title: USA: Hostage standoff follows Philadelphia robbery bid.
newsitem.headline: Hostage standoff follows Philadelphia robbery bid.

text.p: Police were trying to obtain the release of hostages taken after a robbery attempt on Friday at a check-cashing business in northeast Philadelphia, authorities said.

Local media reported that some 30 to 60 employees and customers of the Financial Exchange had been taken hostage, but Philadelphia police spokeswoman Carmen Torres said she could not confirm the number. Media reports said it was unclear whether perpetrators remained in the building and police were hoping for a gradual release of those inside.

Philadelphia police officials told reporters on the scene 40-60 people were being held and as many as eight robbers were involved, although it was not certain whether any thieves remained in the building.
